title: 第二十一章 骑士侍从星陨长剑第二十二章 魔法传说黑气淬体
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 黑石城有五十多名准骑士。
一部分是像他们这些来学习的贵族子弟，也就是来当骑士侍童的。
另一部分是从守城军里面靠战功拼杀出来的小队长。
这些准骑士之中，有十几人成为了黑石城五大骑士的骑士侍从。
李奥想到自己未来会不会成为黑石城第六位骑士伊芙的骑士侍从。
或许拉福林骑士有这个想法。
对于普通人来说，成为骑士侍从其实是一件非常值得自豪的事。
因为骑士之路异常艰辛。
大多数普通人，穷极一生可能都无法摸到骑士的门槛。
所以成为骑士侍从也算是一条很好的出路。
侍从们常年跟随正式骑士出入战场，是骑士非常亲近的战友。
所以大多数骑士侍从都是骑士身边最为亲近的人。
也算是找到了一个强大的靠山。
正如管家伯顿的儿子佐罗，便是靠着战功起家，成为高阶骑士拉福林的骑士侍从。
作为拉福林的侍从，佐罗获得了拉福林提供的大量资源。
他在灰石城的地位也是非常之高。
“走一步看一步。先去把御马技能肝满。”
李奥带着亚瑟快步离开。
而他们身后，罗格和艾迪则是看着两人的背影。
艾迪面色凝重。
“这么短的时间便已经获得了学习呼吸法的机会，看来李奥将来会是一个非常棘手的竞争对手。”艾迪看起来像是自言自语，余光则是在打量着另一边的罗格。
“呵，呼吸法可不是那么容易学会的东西。身体、脑子、资源缺一不可，很快他就会知道什么叫真正的艰难。”罗格已经学习呼吸法半年，光是背气律表他就背了三个月，直到现在还没有熟练掌握。
正当两人说话之间。
“咦？你们俩这变脸也太快了。”霍顿不知何时不声不响地出现在了两人的身后。
罗格吓了一跳，他一直忽视了亚瑟的这个透明小跟班。
此时只能以假笑掩饰自己的尴尬。
“切。”霍顿不再和两人废话，快步朝着马厩方向跟了过去。
当李奥给他的白马换上了更大一号的马掌。
他才发现，他的白马似乎在这十来天的时间里，个头又长大了一点。
李奥仰着头，看向这匹属于自己的白马。
可能是由于缺少参照物，天天看着，所以没有察觉到变化。
这就是五级御马的效果。
【御马五级100100（精神+0.5，经过自己驯养的马匹潜能将不断提升，效果和精神属性相关）】
通过这次换马掌，李奥成功地将自己身上的第二个技能经验肝满。
亚瑟和霍格帮李奥准备好工具和材料，做好这些前期准备工作，这两人就在一边研究起伊芙的那把剑。
剩下来这些可以获得经验的操作，李奥全部都是自己亲力亲为。
和【剑手】职业一样，【御马】职业肝满之后。
李奥看到自己的未就职职业一栏，出现了一个新的上位职业。
【未就职职业：驯兽师（绿）】
查看就职条件。
【驯兽师（未就职）
就职条件：
1.精神属性达到1.6，当前1.4（未满足）
2.敏捷属性达到1.1，当前1.0（未满足）】
content_en:
There are more than fifty would-be knights in Black Rock City.
Some of them are aristocratic children like them who come to study, that is, to serve as knight boys.
The other part is the squad captains who have fought their way out of the city defenders through battle.
Among these quasi-knights, a dozen of them became knight attendants of the five major knights of Black Rock City.
Leo thought about whether he would become the knight attendant of Eve, the sixth knight of Black Rock City in the future.
Maybe Laughlin Knight has this idea.
For ordinary people, becoming a knight's squire is actually a very proud thing.
Because the road of knighthood is extremely difficult.
Most ordinary people may not be able to reach the threshold of a knight in their lifetime.
So becoming a knight's squire is also a good way out.
The attendants follow the official knights to and from the battlefield all year round and are very close comrades-in-arms to the knights.
Therefore, most of the knight's squires are the closest people to the knight.
It can be regarded as finding a strong backer.
Just like Zorro, the son of Butler Burton, he started his career through military exploits and became a knight attendant of the high-ranking knight Laughlin.
As Laughlin's squire, Zorro received a lot of resources provided by Laughlin.
His status in Greystone City is also very high.
"Take it one step at a time. Let's improve our horse control skills first."
Leo took Arthur and left quickly.
Behind them, Roger and Eddie were looking at their backs.
Eddie looked solemn.
"Having been given the opportunity to learn breathing techniques in such a short period of time, it seems that Leo will be a very difficult competitor in the future." Eddie seemed to be talking to himself, and he was looking at Rogge on the other side with his peripheral vision.
"Oh, the breathing method is not something that is easy to learn. The body, brain, and resources are all indispensable. Soon he will know what real hardship is." Rogge has been learning the breathing method for half a year, and he has only memorized the air rhythm table for three months. He has not yet mastered it.
While the two were talking.
"Huh? You two changed your attitude too quickly." Holden appeared behind the two of them silently at some point.
Roger was startled. He had been ignoring Arthur's transparent little follower.
At this time, he could only hide his embarrassment with a fake smile.
"Tch." Holden stopped talking nonsense to the two of them and quickly followed in the direction of the stables.
…
When Leo replaced his white horse with a larger horseshoe.
Only then did he realize that his white horse seemed to have grown a little bigger in the past ten days.
Leo raised his head and looked at his own white horse.
Maybe it’s because I lack a reference and look at it every day, so I don’t notice any changes.
This is the effect of level five horse riding.
[Horse Level 5 100100 (Spirit +0.5, the potential of the horse you have tamed will continue to increase, the effect is related to the mental attributes)]
Through this change of horseshoe, Leo successfully filled his second skill experience.
Arthur and Hogg helped Leo prepare tools and materials and complete these preliminary preparations. The two men studied Eve's sword on the side.
Leo did all the remaining operations that gained experience by himself.
Like the [Swordsman] profession, the [Horse] profession will become available after the liver is full.
Leo saw a new higher-level occupation appearing in his unemployed occupation column.
[Unemployed occupation: Animal Tamer (green)]
View employment requirements.
[Animal Tamer (not yet employed)
Employment requirements:
1. The mental attribute reaches 1.6, currently 1.4 (not satisfied)
2. Agility attribute reaches 1.1, currently 1.0 (not satisfied)]
